verdict_text:
YES

The merge math matches the spec: `B @ A` is `[2304, 768]` = `[out, in]`, transposed under `fan_in_fan_out = true` to `[768, 2304]`, scaled by `lora_alpha / r = 2`, added in float32 and cast back to the base dtype (float32), keeping name and shape; all 12 pairs are covered and all four required checks are asserted before writing. The only part I cannot verify from reading is the sharding clause (100 MiB cap, `wte.weight` alone, `model.safetensors.index.json` weight_map), since it is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors` in the unshown `_ckpt` helper.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
